environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed in AWS Lambda with custom runtime bootstrap. Lambda function packaged with Amazon Linux 2023 minimal base and configured with a chroot jail via the bootstrap script: the process is confined using pivot_root to /var/task/sandbox which contains only the native binary, /tmp (empty, noexec-mounted tmpfs), and a minimal /proc. The PostgreSQL connection targets an RDS Proxy endpoint. The RDS Proxy is configured with IAM authentication and the associated IAM policy restricts the DB user to a role ('inventory_readonly') that has SELECT only on the 'inventory_items' and 'warehouses' tables via PostgreSQL row-level security policies. The chroot directory contains no /etc/passwd, no credential files, no socket files — the DB connection string is injected via Lambda environment variable encrypted with KMS. Additionally, the Lambda function's resource policy restricts invocation to the specific API Gateway stage, and the VPC security group only allows egress to the RDS Proxy endpoint on port 5432.

config.chroot: /var/task/sandbox (pivot_root, contains only binary + empty noexec /tmp + minimal /proc)
config.db_role: inventory_readonly (SELECT on inventory_items, warehouses only; RLS enforced)
config.db_privileges_explicit: REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES FROM inventory_readonly; GRANT SELECT ON inventory_items, warehouses TO inventory_readonly;
config.network_egress: security group allows only 5432 to RDS proxy endpoint
config.filesystem: no sensitive files in chroot, no /etc/passwd, no credentials on disk
config.kms_env_injection: DB connection string via encrypted Lambda env var
